devices.name: Dnt - LoRaWAN® Asset Tracker Solar
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Asset Tracker Solar (dnt-lw-ats) is a reliable and compact GNSS tracker with a water- and dust proof housing according to IP44. Through the built-in solar cell, self-sufficient operation is possible. The position determination can be done cyclically or motion-based. In addition, there are many configuration options through LoRaWAN® downlinks, like the motion sensitivity or the positioning interval. The average sleep mode current is below 10 µA.

devices.name: Dnt - LoRaWAN® Switch Actuator and Meter for brand switches
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Switch Actuator and Meter for brand switches is the ideal solution for intelligent control of lights and other electrical loads in public buildings such as schools, industrial plants, government facilities, hotels, or offices. It can be deployed within existing infrastructure and offers remote control via downlinks or directly on the device using the mounted switch plate.

devices.name: Dnt - LoRaWAN® distance sensor 1
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Distance Sensor 1 (dnt-lw-dis) is a robust LoRaWAN® device for measuring distances outdoors. With its measuring range of 4 to 360 cm, the easy-to-install housing and various configuration options it can be used for a wide range of applications.

devices.name: Dnt - LoRaWAN® energy sensor interface
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® energy sensor intefrace (dnt-lw-esi) is a battery powered device to integrate smart meters into the LoRaWAN® network. It can collect data from electricity and gas meters with different sensors.

devices.name: Dnt - LoRaWAN® Radiator Thermostat Controllable
devices.description: 'The dnt® LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat Controllable (dnt-lw-eTRV-C) enables two ways to adjust the room temperature: directly on the device with the integrated buttons or remote control via Downlinks. It features an always-on e-paper display to show the current temperature settings, three customizable heating profiles with up to ten switching times per day, a window open detection to automatically reduce temperature and the possibility to perform a dynamic adaptive adjustment of the radiator. Because of very low energy consumption, a battery life up to 3 years can be archived.'

devices.name: Dnt - LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat (dnt-lw-eTRV) enables remote control of the room temperature. It features three customizable heating profiles with up to ten switching times per day. Because of very low energy consumption of only 3.8 uA, a battery life up to 5 years can be archived.

devices.name: Dnt - LoRaWAN® window sensor and contact interface
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® window sensor and contact interface can detect the state of a window of a door (open/closed) via the integrated magnetometer or the contact interface. Besides an external reed contact, it is also possible to attach a glas-break sensor to the contact interface to use the device in security context.

devices.name: Dnt - LoRaWAN® Wall Thermostat
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Wall Thermostat (dnt-lw-wth) controls the heating or air conditioning of the room. It measures the room temperature and humidity and shows it on the integrated Display. For automatic adjustment of the room temperature, the user can configure three profiles with each up to ten temperature changes a day. Other features are the window-open detection, a holiday mode, an energy-saving mode and various configuration options through LoRaWAN downlinks. Through our low power design, the device consumes only 45 uA in default mode, which results in a battery lifetime of up to 5 years.
